messages:
Maria: Preparing a small routing policy split for eu-edge to shift ~15% traffic to the new instance group tomorrow at 03:00 UTC. Wanted to flag coordination here and ask who can own the deploy and smoke checks.
Alex: I can kick the deploy and watch the initial metrics.
Tanvi: I can own smoke tests and live latency dashboards for the first 30m.
Kai: I will be on-call during that window; can handle quick rollbacks if needed.
Sam: heads-up: I have a backup for rollback runbook in case we need to revert routes fast.
Maria: Thanks. Plan is: small split, validate success criteria (error-rate < 0.3% and p95 latency change <= +20ms), hold 20m, then ramp to 50%. If any alarms fire, rollback immediately.
Alex: Confirmed. What's the exact routing change command?
Maria: Using the routing service CLI, example below. I'll paste the exact command I'll run during the deploy:
```
redwood-routectl set-split --policy eu-edge-v2 --from eu-edge-v1 --to eu-edge-v2 --weight 15
```
Maria: After the split I'll run these checks: 1) /health across canaries, 2) synthetic query p99, 3) token/cost counters sanity.
Tanvi: For smoke I'll run the synthetic against eu-edge-v2 and eu-edge-v1, plus a small user flow test hitting session state.
Kai: Deploy time sounds good. I'll be ready to throttle traffic back via: `redwood-routectl set-split --policy eu-edge-v2 --weight 0` if we need immediate rollback.
ops-bot: :information_source: Reminder: maintenance window quota opens 02:45-04:00 UTC. No other deploys allowed in that window per policy.
Alex: I'll coordinate with deploy-bot to create the canary rollout job and attach the smoke checklist.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary rollout job created: job/rollout-1832109876. Ping @Alex for approvals.
Tanvi: Quick note: I'll capture perf traces and upload to the console; please don't prune trace retention until I confirm.
Maria: Also toggling the KV cache warmup on the new group before the split. Command I'll run: `kvcachectl prewarm --group eu-edge-v2 --keys 10000`.
Alex: Got it. Timeline summary: 02:55 UTC prewarm, 03:00 UTC 15% split, monitor 20m, 03:20 ramp to 50% if green.
Sam: I'll attach the rollback runbook link here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-edge. Keep it handy.
Maria: If all clear at 04:00 we'll mark the task done and schedule the follow-up postmortem notes. If anyone sees anything odd after 03:00 call it out immediately in this thread. :rocket:
Kai: Acknowledged. I'll be in the call and on standby.
Alex: Ready to start.
Tanvi: Ready.
Maria: Awesome — thanks team.
